name: WPA Free Card Pre-Registry Intake Policy
purpose: Provide a privacy-minimised expression-of-interest route for people who want to be considered for the future WPA Free Card while the authoritative membership registry is not yet active.

consent_contract.withdrawal_route: Reply by email requesting removal from the pre-registry interest list.

privacy_rules: Do not request government identifiers, payment data, passwords, sensitive-category data or unnecessary personal data.
An expression of interest is not membership and creates no entitlement, credential, benefit or partnership status.
When a real membership registry/backend is activated, publish the applicable privacy notice, retention rules, access controls and deletion process before migrating or collecting registry data.
Do not publish applicant names or email addresses in public repositories or public verification surfaces.
